inspiration.observed_pattern: A UNION of identical latest-key rows feeds two JSON_TABLE grouped branches; duplicate set rows must not multiply aggregate counts.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reduced to one channel, two stream rows, and one download row with one bucket so UNION distinct semantics alone determine whether the download branch passes HAVING COUNT(*) > 1.

fixture_notes: The stream branch has two observations and passes the threshold. The download branch has one observation and must be filtered out; a duplicated UNION key incorrectly makes it appear twice.
determinism_notes: The single channel, capture date, JSON arrays, threshold, and final ordering are fixed. No clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE mini_stream_snapshots (channel_id INT NOT NULL, capture_day DATE NOT NULL, samples JSON NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE mini_download_snapshots (channel_id INT NOT NULL, capture_day DATE NOT NULL, samples JSON NOT NULL)

steps.sql: WITH latest_dates AS (SELECT channel_id, MAX(capture_day) AS capture_day FROM mini_stream_snapshots GROUP BY channel_id UNION SELECT channel_id, MAX(capture_day) AS capture_day FROM mini_download_snapshots GROUP BY channel_id), stream_summary AS (SELECT s.channel_id, samples.bucket_no, COUNT(*) AS observation_count FROM mini_stream_snapshots AS s INNER JOIN latest_dates AS latest ON latest.channel_id = s.channel_id AND latest.capture_day = s.capture_day CROSS JOIN JSON_TABLE(s.samples, '$[*]' COLUMNS (bucket_no FOR ORDINALITY, value INT PATH '$')) AS samples GROUP BY s.channel_id, samples.bucket_no HAVING COUNT(*) > 1), download_summary AS (SELECT d.channel_id, samples.bucket_no, COUNT(*) AS observation_count FROM mini_download_snapshots AS d INNER JOIN latest_dates AS latest ON latest.channel_id = d.channel_id AND latest.capture_day = d.capture_day CROSS JOIN JSON_TABLE(d.samples, '$[*]' COLUMNS (bucket_no FOR ORDINALITY, value INT PATH '$')) AS samples GROUP BY d.channel_id, samples.bucket_no HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) SELECT stream_summary.channel_id, stream_summary.bucket_no, stream_summary.observation_count AS stream_observations, download_summary.observation_count AS download_observations FROM stream_summary LEFT JOIN download_summary ON download_summary.channel_id = stream_summary.channel_id AND download_summary.bucket_no = stream_summary.bucket_no ORDER BY stream_summary.channel_id, stream_summary.bucket_no
